notes: People come find you. Characters who trust you (55+) or are dating you sometimes show up on their own, without being texted: because they missed you, were bored, brought food, have news to tell you in person, or were passing by. It happens during the day (9 to 22), only when they're free, more often the closer you are and the better their mood, at most once every ten hours. If you're sick, close friends may turn up with soup and medicine. If you're not there when they arrive, they remember it.
